        assert describe(None) == "items=0"

    def test_describe_nested_list(self):
        """Test that describe does not recurse into nested lists."""
        data = [[1, 2], 3]
        assert describe(data) == "items=1"

    def test_describe_all_non_integers(self):
        """Test that describe returns items=0 when list has no integers."""
        data = ["a", "b", 1.1, 2.2]
        assert describe(data) == "items=0"

    def test_describe_bool_values(self):
        """Test that describe counts boolean values as integers."""
        data = [True, False, 1]
        assert describe(data) == "items=3"

    def test_describe_large_list(self):
        """Test that describe handles a large list correctly."""
        data = list(range(100))
        assert describe(data) == "items=100"
